units.source_text: 「好，算我輸吧。不過我告訴你，藥物和醫生出乎意外的還都屬於喜（喜劇的略稱）呢，那麼，死呢？」

en.t: All right, I will admit defeat. But let me tell you, medicine and doctors, surprisingly enough, both belong to comedy, the abbreviation for comedy. So then, what about death?
Comedy. Priests and monks are the same.
Correct! Then living must be tragedy, right?

units.source_text: 「不，這麼說，一切都成了喜。我再問你一個問題，漫畫家呢？這個總不能說是喜了吧？」

en.t: No, if you put it that way, everything becomes comedy. Let me ask you one more question: what about cartoonists? Surely you cannot call that comedy, can you?
Tragedy, tragedy. A major tragic noun.

units.source_text: 「什麼呀，我看你才是一個大悲劇呢。」

en.t: What are you talking about? I think you are the real great tragedy.

units.source_text: 變成了這樣如此低階的遊戲，雖然無聊，

en.t: The game had turned into something this crude, and though it was boring,

units.source_text: 但我們自己對這種在世界的沙龍裡，未曾有人玩過的智慧遊戲感到得意。

en.t: we ourselves took pride in this clever game that had never been played in any salon in the world.
